command.displayText: BANK ALERT: Suspicious charge of $1,248.50 at Target. Reply YES if this was you, or NO to speak with Fraud Prevention. Or click the link to dispute this yourself.

option.text: Click the link in the text
Ignore the text and log into the official banking app

command.displayText: The link opens a fake banking portal asking for your username, password, and Social Security number. This is a phishing trap.
You open the official banking app yourself. Your real balance is fine and no pending charge exists. Scam defeated.

The caller says: Thank you for responding. We see a hacker actively attempting to drain your account. To secure your funds, we need to move them to a temporary FDIC-secured government safe vault immediately.

option.text: Hang up and call the number on the back of your debit card
Ask the caller to verify their employee identity

command.displayText: The caller says: I have initiated the secure transfer to protect your money. I am texting you a verification code right now. Read it out loud so I can finalize the security vault.

option.text: Read the code out loud to the caller
Read the text message carefully before speaking

command.displayText: The text says: Security Code: 994-123. Bank employees will NEVER ask for this code over the phone. Do not share it.

option.text: Realize it is a scam, hang up, and call the bank fraud line
Trust the caller anyway and give them the code

command.displayText: Win condition: You stopped the scam and contacted the bank through an official channel.
Critical loss: The scammer used the code to bypass two-factor authentication and compromise the account.
